motion.name: caret-blink
motion.purpose: Terminal caret only; equalizer movement obeys prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Active language pill
components.description: Current locale in the status bar.
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-block; padding:3px 7px; font:700 12px/1.2 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; border-radius:0; } .ds-pill--on { background:#A8E05B; color:#0A0C0A; }

components.name: Passive language pill
components.description: Available locale in the status bar.
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-block; padding:3px 7px; font:400 12px/1.2 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; border-radius:0; } .ds-pill--off { border:1px solid #2A322A; color:#93A08F; } .ds-pill--off:hover { color:#C4EC8A; }

narrative.overview: A flat, dark terminal-inspired portfolio where the work remains primary and rare lime signals mark state, focus, and action.
keyCharacteristics: Static vertical grid and editorial rail

rules.name: Rare Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime represents a state or action, never a broad decorative fill.

rules.name: Single Voice Rule
rules.body: New interface elements inherit the mono system.

dos: Use existing colour roles and JetBrains Mono.
donts: Do not add rounded cards, gradients, glass decoration, or a new colour family.
Do not make the equalizer decorative only.
